title: News India - Website
description: A dynamic and responsive news web app to aggregate and display news articles from sources in real-time. The project ensures seamless data fetching, category-based filtering, and smooth routing using React Router.

title: Communion Hub - Community Event Platform
description: Communion Hub is a web platform that allows users to discover, create, and join meaningful events. It fosters connection, interaction, and engagement within diverse communities, while offering a space to give and receive support.

title: Portfolio Resume - Personal Website
description: A responsive and animated portfolio website built to showcase personal projects, technical skills, and contact information. Features smooth scroll navigation, section-based layout, and modern UI components for a professional online presence.

title: Chat-App
description: A real-time messaging platform with support for text, media sharing, and social media integration. Built for secure and seamless communication across devices.

title: Game Night – Website
description: An interactive game website where users can play, score, and share results. Features a dynamic UI, smooth gameplay, and social sharing.

title: E-Commerce Website
description: An intuitive and responsive e-commerce platform designed to deliver a smooth online shopping experience, with product browsing, cart management, user authentication, and secure order processing on a scalable backend.

title: Drive Website
description: A cloud-based file storage and management platform inspired by Google Drive, allowing users to securely upload, preview, and manage files with authentication and cloud storage integration.
